review.name: Voxagine engine full static review
review.baseline_subject: Phase 4d: shrink the CPU voxel from 16 B to 4 B, owner beside it (#15)
review.working_tree_note: The worktree remained active during the review. User/IDE-owned modifications observed outside the review artifacts include CMakeLists.txt, CMakePresets.json, README.md, Voxagine/Source/Core/Utils/DateTime.h, and Rider .idea run configurations. Untracked runtime settings files also appeared under Voxagine/Source. All were preserved and were not authored or reverted by this review; index hashes identify the exact final source snapshot while the Git review baseline remains revision 743c4c6.

methods: rendering, voxel, physics, chunk, pathfinding, input, audio, editor, allocator, filesystem, and timing review

verification.name: game-release
verification.notes: Verified revision 743c4c6; produced voxagine_vulkan.lib, voxagine.lib, rttr_core.dll, and BitBuster.exe.

verification.name: editor-release
verification.notes: Fresh VOXAGINE_BUILD_EDITOR=ON configure compiled and linked the Vulkan library, full editor engine library, RTTR, shaders, and BitBuster.exe. First-party warnings are indexed as VX-BUILD-005; the missing VoxFrame return is VX-VOX-006.

verification.name: automated-tests
verification.notes: Legacy GoogleTest sources exist but root CMake does not enable or register them with CTest.

verification.name: runtime-smoke
verification.notes: No graphical/audio session was launched during this static review.

verification.name: human-report-docx
verification.command: documents render_docx.py plus structural document audits
verification.notes: The DOCX contains all 88 finding headings; accessibility, section, inline-image, placeholder, and exact table-geometry audits passed. LibreOffice and Microsoft Word were not installed, so page PNG rendering and visual page-by-page inspection could not be completed.
